    Why We Exist

    One Voice. One Nation. One Future.

    New Nigeria Unity is a non-partisan, citizen-led grassroots initiative dedicated to fostering peace, unity, and shared identity across Nigeria's diverse communities. Through storytelling, cultural exchange, and creative campaigns, it highlights voices from all 36 states and the FCT — showing how Tiv, Igbo, Hausa, Yoruba, and many others contribute to one national narrative.

    01

    Bridge, not divide

    NNU is non-partisan and citizen-led — built to connect Nigerians across ethnic, religious, and regional lines, not to represent any one of them.

    02

    Grassroots by design

    The movement operates across all 36 states and the FCT, powered by real stories from real communities — not top-down messaging.

    03

    Peace in practice

    Every episode, post, and campaign shows unity already happening in Nigeria — proof, not persuasion.

    Every handshake starts with a story. Tell us yours.

    We're building this movement one real story at a time — not stock quotes. If unity showed up in your community this week, we want to hear it, and may feature it in an upcoming episode or post.
